mechanics.claim: Malphite dashes with displacement immunity and cannot be deterred by crowd control during the dash.
mechanics.quote: The dash cannot be deterred by {{tip|crowd control}}.

mechanics.claim: Damage and knockup are dealt only upon arrival at the destination, to nearby enemies in the effect radius, not along the path.
mechanics.quote: Upon arrival, he deals {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies and briefly {{tip|airborne|knocks them up}}.

mechanics.claim: If Malphite dies during the dash, the ability cancels and deals no damage.
mechanics.quote: If '''Malphite''' dies during his {{tip|dash}}, the ability cancels.

mechanics.claim: The ability can be blocked by a spell shield.
